project.name: autojobs
project.description: 自动化脚本控制中台；当前已实现 M0 Windows 本机执行端

stack.frontend: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite（apps/agent/desktop-ui 本机窗口）
stack.jobs: Python 3.12 + SQLite + pywin32 + pywebview（apps/agent 本地执行链路）

lint: uv run --project apps/agent --frozen --extra desktop ruff check apps/agent/src apps/agent/tests apps/agent/examples
typecheck: uv run --project apps/agent --frozen --extra desktop mypy --config-file apps/agent/pyproject.toml apps/agent/src/autojobs_agent
unit: uv run --project apps/agent --frozen --extra desktop pytest apps/agent/tests -m "not integration and not windows" -q
integration: uv run --project apps/agent --frozen --extra desktop pytest apps/agent/tests -m "integration or windows" -q
